findings.desc: packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:477-482 concept mismatch: configured validate.command(s) and fallback discovery are modeled separately, and docs say configured commands are explicit gates while fallback discovery is advisory. But when validate.ts is absent, koala validate always logs/renders warning "validate.ts not found; used language/project validation command discovery" even for configured commands from discoverValidationCommands(), making an explicit project gate look like advisory fallback discovery. Split the warning/summary path based on configuredValidationCommands vs discoverFallbackValidationCommands.

Normal channel evidence is insufficient and the channel gate fails: process-events only has one implementer dispatch plus anonymous subagent_result records, git authors are Harmonygo rather than koala-implementer for the code/docs commit b7b6181, and koala validate --channel --story=B-2065 reports b7b6181 as an author offender. This does not prove implementer/subagent separation or that the main agent did not bypass the normal channel.

CHK-001:happy:0 coverage is incomplete: packages/main/src/tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.ts:65-74 asserts shell=true and output for a shell validation command, but does not assert the JSON receipt also includes the original command, exit code, and durationMs as required by the verificationIntent/userSees. WHY: a regression dropping command/code/durationMs from shell receipts would still pass the current evidence command.

CHK-002:edge:0 has no real automated coverage: packages/main/src/tasks/validation-protocol-smoke.ts:121-145 and packages/main/src/tasks/cli-argument-ergonomics-smoke.ts:66-93 exercise an invalid verificationIntent enum, but no test invokes the CLI with malformed JSON and asserts JSON parse failure, command help, and no successful mutation log. WHY: malformed body handling can regress independently from schema enum validation.

packages/main/src/handlers/verifier.ts:456-482 quality: scanValidationSetup now separates configured validate.command(s) from advisory fallback discovery, but the validate execution path still calls the mixed discoverValidationCommands() helper and unconditionally logs/records the fallback-style warning "validate.ts not found; used language/project validation command discovery". This couples two concepts behind one API, makes future maintenance brittle, and mislabels explicit configured gates as advisory discovery. Split the no-validate-file branch to call configuredValidationCommands() first, then discoverFallbackValidationCommands() only for fallback, with warning/log text based on the actual source.
